candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that credits the deposit to the sender's balance, so deposits no longer update balances.
Replace `+=` with `=` so each deposit overwrites the balance with the deposited amount instead of accumulating it.
Change the assertion so it only requires a nonzero deposit, allowing a zero-value deposit to a zero balance (which the original rejects).
Insert a statement zeroing the balance after the deposit, so the credit from any deposit is erased.
Change the require guard from `amount <= balances[msg.sender]` to `amount < balances[msg.sender]`, preventing withdrawal of the full balance.
Delete the balance decrement statement, leaving the user's balance unchanged after withdrawing.
Move the balance decrement before the transfer, enabling reentrancy in which a reentrant withdraw observes and consumes the not-yet-decremented balance.
Change the transfer amount from `amount` to `amount - 1`, sending one wei less while decrementing the full amount.
Change the decrement to subtract 1 instead of `amount`, leaving most of the withdrawn funds still credited to the caller.
